boat.full_description: Presumably a mould taken from a genuine wooden smack's boat. Now fitted with modernised balanced lug rig including 4:1 down haul on the luff, sail out haul and slab reefing with downhauls. Back haul (bleater) on the boom. Centre plate is steel with 2:1 lifting gear. Said to have been owned by someone in Manningtree, although a Guga is a Hebridean Gannet.
boat.name: Guga
boat.short_description: 12 ft Smacks Boat. Early OGA mould.
